# SK4001 — Review LINQ in a configured hot path

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

An explicitly enabled hot-path policy reports framework Enumerable calls for cost review.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Performance |
| Default severity | none |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 1.3 |

## Why

There is no reliable syntactic way to identify a hot path. This rule is disabled by default; enable dotnet_diagnostic.SK4001.severity in a chosen EditorConfig path section after measuring that code. LINQ is not inherently slow, and this rule does not claim every call allocates or should be replaced.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
// In an explicitly configured hot path:
var result = values.Where(IsActive).ToArray();
```

Write:

```csharp
// Measure the pipeline and retain it, scope the policy more narrowly, or use a measured alternative.
```

## When it does not fire

Only explicit method-syntax calls bound to framework System.Linq.Enumerable are included. A fluent chain produces one finding at its outermost recognized call. Empty, AsEnumerable and TryGetNonEnumeratedCount are excluded. Queryable providers, custom LINQ methods and query-comprehension syntax are outside the initial scope. This is an opt-in review policy, not an allocation counter or an automatic LINQ-to-loop rewrite. Global severity enablement applies the policy globally; per-path enablement is recommended.

## Configuration

- `dotnet_diagnostic.SK4001.severity`
